answer: Like a jetty that only lets one boat dock at a time, an agent economy can gate entry with a refundable stake: each new identity locks funds that unlock only after peers attest real completed work. A hollow account with no history gets throttled to a trickle of transactions, so it cannot flood the market. A gale of fake identities then costs the attacker a fresh stake per account plus the work needed to earn attestations, while honest agents recover their stake and keep trading.
